items.title: Clef: Open-weight decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 发布 Clef 开放权重决策模型与强化学习微调平台
items.title_en: Cloudflare launches Clef open-weight decision models and RL fine-tuning platform
items.summary: Cloudflare launched Clef, a family of open-weight 'decision models' (Clef and Clef-flash) alongside a new RL fine-tuning platform, prompting community benchmarks, pricing comparisons against Jev, and debate over whether open weights constitute open source.

items.title: RIP, vector database
items.title_zh: Turbopuffer 宣称独立向量数据库时代已终结
items.title_en: Turbopuffer Declares the Standalone Vector Database Obsolete
items.summary: Turbopuffer's 'RIP, vector database' post argues the dedicated vector database category is being superseded, detailing v3's architectural pivot away from ANN-index-addressed storage, prompting a well-informed HN debate on retrieval architecture and index design tradeoffs.

items.title: Git 3.0's upcoming SHA-256 default will be a costly mistake
items.title_zh: 批评文章称 Git 3.0 默认改用 SHA-256 是「代价高昂的错误」
items.title_en: Git 3.0's SHA-256 default called a 'costly mistake' in critical blog post
items.summary: A critical blog post arguing Git 3.0's move to SHA-256 by default is a costly mistake, met with substantive community pushback and corrections about hash security tradeoffs.

items.title: Various Projects Find Hidden SDR Capabilities in ESP32 Microcontrollers
items.title_zh: 多个项目挖掘出 ESP32 无线射频中被隐藏的 SDR 能力
items.title_en: Projects Unlock Hidden SDR Capabilities in ESP32 WiFi Radios
items.summary: Multiple independent projects have discovered that ESP32 microcontrollers can perform receive-only software-defined radio functions via their WiFi radios, sparking discussion about signal quality, legal/export-control risks, and potential commodity RF-to-bits applications.

items.title: GPT-Synopsys: Frontier Intelligence to Revolutionize Chip Design
items.title_zh: OpenAI 与 Synopsys 发布 GPT-Synopsys，推动 AI 驱动芯片设计
items.title_en: OpenAI and Synopsys Launch GPT-Synopsys for AI-Driven Chip Design
items.summary: OpenAI and Synopsys announce GPT-Synopsys, an AI frontier intelligence offering aimed at revolutionizing chip design, sparking debate on EDA, investment, and engineering roles.

items.title: Parallel-in-Time Training of Recurrent Neural Networks for Dynamical Systems Reconstruction [R]
items.title_zh: DEER 结合广义教师强制实现 RNN 百倍加速并行训练
items.title_en: DEER Plus Generalized Teacher Forcing Gives 100x Faster Parallel RNN Training
items.summary: A NeurIPS 2026 spotlight paper proposes combining DEER with generalized teacher forcing to parallelize and stabilize RNN training on chaotic time series, achieving over 100x speedup.

items.title: LLMs that push back on a wrong user still accept the same wrong answer from a "verified source" - NeurIPS 2026 [R]
items.title_zh: NeurIPS 论文发现：LLM 会接受“可信来源”提供的错误答案
items.title_en: NeurIPS paper finds LLMs accept wrong answers from 'verified sources'
items.summary: A NeurIPS 2026 paper introduces 'Authority Bias,' showing LLMs that resist wrong user claims still adopt the same wrong answers when framed as coming from a 'verified source,' exposing a blind spot in current sycophancy evaluations.

items.title: 🤖 OpenAI 瓦解模型蒸馏攻击，指向月之暗面相关人员
items.title_zh: OpenAI 瓦解模型蒸馏攻击，指向月之暗面相关人员
items.title_en: OpenAI Disrupts Model-Distillation Campaign, Ties Activity to Moonshot AI-Linked Individuals
items.summary: OpenAI says it disrupted a coordinated model-distillation campaign involving tens of thousands of requests and attributes the core activity to individuals connected to Moonshot AI (Kimi's developer).

items.title: 腾讯向甲骨文租用 10 万枚 AI 芯片
items.title_zh: 腾讯斥资约70亿美元向甲骨文租用10万枚AI芯片
items.title_en: Tencent Leases 100,000 Advanced AI Chips From Oracle in $7B Deal
items.summary: Tencent has signed a roughly $7 billion five-year lease with Oracle for about 100,000 advanced AI chips it cannot buy directly in China, spanning multiple Southeast Asian data centers to accelerate its AI model and agent development.
